lines.zh: 枪托抵着我的肩，我往前走
lines.en: Stock against my shoulder, I advance

lines.zh: 我的靴子踩碎下界的岩渣
lines.en: My boots crush Nether slag

lines.zh: 身上的护甲还带着旧弹孔
lines.en: My armor still carries old bullet holes
I advance in a low crouch
I work along the wall for cover
My muzzle stays pointed forward
I swap a magazine without stopping
Firelight stretches my outline
My breathing keeps a steady rhythm

lines.zh: 我踩过一片冷却的岩浆壳
lines.en: I cross a crust of cooled lava

lines.zh: 我用前脚掌落地，几乎没有声音
lines.en: I land on the balls of my feet, almost silent

lines.zh: 我一格一格地推进阵线
lines.en: I push the line forward one block at a time
I lean on the wall, rifle still up

lines.zh: 我的手指在扳机外停着
lines.en: My finger rests outside the trigger
I listen for movement ahead
A little light seeps from my armor joints
I look down to check the action

lines.zh: 这身军装早就不是原来的颜色
lines.en: This uniform lost its color long ago

lines.zh: 我一动不动地守着这个位置
lines.en: I hold this position without moving
My eyes sweep the dark

lines.zh: 我在等命令，但没人下令
lines.en: I wait for orders that never come
I push my helmet up a little
Halt, go no farther
You are not on my list

lines.zh: 我的枪口对着你的胸口
lines.en: My muzzle is on your chest
Get your hands up
This area has been cleared
I see your breathing is fast
You are not one of us
I am counting what you carry
Last warning

lines.zh: 你不该在这个时候出现
lines.en: You should not have shown up now
The armor stopped some, but it hurts
My teeth grind, but I make no sound
My shoulder plate is pierced
I press the wound and keep the rifle up
This body is used to it
Blood drips through the armor joints
I fall back behind cover

lines.zh: 我检查了一下还能不能扣扳机
lines.en: I check whether I can still pull the trigger
This wound does not affect the mission
I am not down yet; carry on
Supplies are not used that way

lines.zh: 你举着它，是想换我的枪口吗
lines.en: Are you holding that up to trade for my muzzle
I find my own supplies
My rations ran out long ago

lines.zh: 这东西挡不住一颗子弹
lines.en: This will not stop a bullet
Lower that hand first
My finger is still outside the trigger

lines.zh: 你继续举着，我就当你投降
lines.en: Keep holding it and I take it as surrender
This does not count as a supply
My mission is not about eating
You hit my armor

lines.zh: 我被顶退了半步，立刻站定
lines.en: I am pushed back half a step and immediately set

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，金属在响
lines.en: We collided, metal ringing
You stepped on my sling
I shove you aside with the rifle
This impact does not affect my aim

lines.zh: 我的肩甲留下一个凹痕
lines.en: A dent is left in my shoulder plate
I reset my stance

lines.zh: 这一撞顶得我退了半步
lines.en: That shove puts me back half a step
Do not move around in front of me
That is outside my mission

lines.zh: 我已经很久不是活人了
lines.en: I have not been a living man for a long time

lines.zh: 我的编制里没有这一项
lines.en: There is no such entry in my unit
Ask someone else about that
I cannot recall the old days
My squad is all gone
I pull my helmet down a little

lines.zh: 这个想法让我握紧了枪
lines.en: That thought made me grip my rifle
Do not bring up the old days
I go on holding this post

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起地上的弹壳
lines.en: I bend down and pick up a casing
I keep this casing to reload
I tuck the ammo into a chest pocket

lines.zh: 补给要留到该用的时候
lines.en: Supplies are saved for when they matter

lines.zh: 我拾起一块碎片看了看
lines.en: I pick up a fragment and look at it
Useless, but I do not throw it away
I hang it on my belt

lines.zh: 地上的一切都可能是补给
lines.en: Anything on the ground might be a supply

lines.zh: 我动作很快，眼睛没离前方
lines.en: I move fast, eyes never leaving the front
I stuff it into my pack
Confirmed, that is the one
It is within my range
I seat the stock firmly
I wait for it to take one more step
No cover at this angle
Leave this one to me
I start shifting position
The round is chambered
I fire on three
Do not expect me to hesitate
Contact, target found
My sights are already on it
I do not shout, I just fire
I will hold this one round
I track it laterally
I hold the sight and wait for its flank
Its movement follows a pattern

lines.zh: 我把距离压在二十格内
lines.en: I keep it inside twenty blocks
I fire one round at a time

lines.zh: 我的呼吸和扣扳机同步
lines.en: My breathing syncs with the trigger
It ducked behind stone

lines.zh: 我换了个更高一点的位置
lines.en: I shift to a slightly higher spot

lines.zh: 我一直在算它的下一步
lines.en: I keep computing its next move
Right now, hold still

lines.zh: 我沿着岩脊绕到它背后
lines.en: I circle the ridge to its back
I can hear its footsteps
I keep it inside my field of fire
When it turns, I fire
My barrel is heating up

lines.zh: 这个掩体挡不住我太久
lines.en: This cover will not last me long
I slam the stock down
At close range I do not aim

lines.zh: 我的护甲先撞进它怀里
lines.en: My armor rams into its chest
I put my whole body into it
I shove it off and fire again
My boot pins its foot
Cordite mixes with the smell of blood
I retreat the moment the blow lands

lines.zh: 这个距离我更习惯用枪
lines.en: I prefer the rifle at this range
I drive the bayonet in
My helmet cracks against its face
I kick its knee out
At close range I strike with the barrel

lines.zh: 我把枪横过来挡住它的爪
lines.en: I turn the rifle across to block its claw

lines.zh: 这一下不为击杀，为脱离
lines.en: This one is not to kill, it is to break away
I miss, and step back at once

lines.zh: 我从下界的火雾里走出来
lines.en: I step out of the Nether's burning haze
The chamber is already loaded

lines.zh: 我的制服上全是烧痕与弹孔
lines.en: My uniform is all burns and bullet holes
My number is still stitched on the cuff
This place needs a sentry
I take the front position
Argent burns inside me

lines.zh: 我又一次被派上了前线
lines.en: I have been sent to the front again
I check my gear once
I do not recall my last rest
The sentry post goes here
The Nether is hotter than the front
Flames lick across my armor

lines.zh: 我从岩壁掉下去，砸在地上
lines.en: I fell off the ridge and hit the ground
Liquid flooded into my helmet
The blast slammed me back down

lines.zh: 中弹了，我早就知道会这样
lines.en: I have been hit, I always knew I would be
That magic passed through the armor
I have had no supplies for a long time
Lightning struck my barrel
I fell out of the line
